_comment: Golden-output manifest for the recorded-format regression matrix (see formatMatrix.test.ts). Each entry pairs a checked-in fixture with the exact values the parser must produce for it. ONLY real recordings (scrubbed with scripts/redact-claude-recording.js) belong here; never a hand-written fixture. Hand-written fixtures live under synthetic/ with their own manifest and test. To extend to another editor's parser, add a sibling top-level key here plus a matching adapter in formatMatrix.test.ts's ADAPTERS map. Costs are priced with the test's mocked table (3 / 15 / 0.3 USD per million), not a real price list.
